newsitem.title: UK: British retail sales rise 0.6 percent in January.
newsitem.headline: British retail sales rise 0.6 percent in January.

text.p: British retail sales rose by 0.6 percent in January for a 4.6 percent year-on-year increase, official figures showed on Wednesday.
The annual figure was the highest since March 1989 and well above market expectations.
Analysts had expected a 0.3 percent monthly rise and a year-on-year increase of 3.9 percent.
Treasury Minister Angela Knight said the figures showed that economic recovery in Britain was continuing but remained under control.
She said sales in British shops remained on a healthy upward path.
